name: SST Threaded-Hole Substrate Blind Falsifier
python: >=3.10; validated source/runtime on Python 3.13 and designed for Python 3.14 Windows
windows_target: MSVC 2022 x64; py::ssize_t portable NumPy indexing
blind_protocol: anonymous active/null candidate geometry + SHA-256 sealed result/code/catalog/config before reveal
major_changes: carrier-clustered inference; repeated beta values are not independent knots
contact-stopped trajectories excluded from ordinary AUC/RPO/Floquet scoring
free radial pressure exponent fit p=A+B/r^nu without Newton target in blind analysis
fine beta pressure-law campaign with odd/even and quartic decomposition
triple-gear geometric phase-lock/rational-winding proxy with no supplied gear ratio
per-thread-beta density mode in addition to fixed-total-beta mode
thread far-return sectors separated to prevent artificial closure contacts
